# Erdős Problems #274 maintained-page excerpt

Retrieved: 2026-08-06 JST (UTC+09:00)

Source: https://www.erdosproblems.com/274

The maintained page marks the problem `OPEN` and states the general
Herzog--Schönheim question: a nontrivial finite family of left cosets with
pairwise distinct subgroup indices should not partition a group.

The page records the subnormal-subgroup case, hence the abelian case, and the
case of groups of order smaller than 1440.  The discussion thread additionally
mentions Sylow-tower groups, orders divisible by few primes, simple groups, and
symmetric groups.  These are restrictions on the group or its order, not a
bound on the number of cosets.

At retrieval, the thread's maintained summary said that no partial or complete
solution was claimed in its comments.  The newest relevant comment was dated
2026-03-14 with no source time zone stated and listed the group-class cases
above.

Claim boundary: the maintained page warns that its open status may omit
literature. It is a status and statement source and does not establish
priority.
